verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio offers an interactive environment for testing agent teams, can set up test endpoints, and can run teams in a Docker container. A community user reports that agent code execution runs in a fresh Docker container by default, which gives isolated sandbox execution. However, nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox that is explicitly separated from production data, or test or mock data environments. Missing for 10: documented sandbox-vs-production data separation, mock or test data tooling, first-party docs on Docker or isolated code executors, independent hands-on corroboration beyond one comment.
